description: Exact pH of a mixture of acids, bases and salts by charge and mass balance — no "x is negligible", no "only the first dissociation" — with the speciation of each weak system and the textbook formula next to it, with its validity rule and how wrong it is here. Every constant comes with the paper or critical compilation it was taken from. Ideal solution at 25 °C. Give listSubstances: true (and no components) to get what it knows.

components.description: What is in the beaker; empty = pure water

substance.description: A table id ("acetico", "fosforico"), the formula of one of its forms as sold ("NaH2PO4", "NH4Cl", "NH3") or a strong one ("HCl", "NaOH", "AgNO3")

name: chem_ph
